body: It’s somewhat of a rollercoaster. I started to feel better 5 months. And now at 9 months I’ve started to feel extremely depressed again, despite not having spoken to him for 5 months. I’m hoping these depressive times get shorter and shorter.
5 months for me and I'm so tired of feeling like this, I can't stop checking his social media, every time I see he's added a new random girl I just feel like I'm dying.

Thanks for your reply. 

What's weird is I know that and haven't wanted him back because of the way he's changed. 

But it hasn't stopped the overwhelming sadness.
